campuses.title: Langley Campus
campuses.text: Main residential campus in Langley, BC — 50 km east of Vancouver in the Fraser Valley, with a scenic wooded setting and strong community atmosphere.

paragraphs: Trinity Western University (TWU) is a private Christian liberal arts university located in Langley, British Columbia. Founded in 1962, TWU offers undergraduate and graduate programs in business, sciences, nursing, education, humanities, and the arts, serving a diverse community of over 4,500 students including a substantial international population.

TWU is known for its strong sense of community, small class sizes, and values-based education. The university's programs in nursing, business, psychology, and education are highly regarded, and its MBA program is a popular choice for international graduate students.

Located in Langley's Fraser Valley, 50 kilometres east of downtown Vancouver, TWU students enjoy access to Metro Vancouver's vast employment and cultural opportunities while benefiting from more affordable housing than central Vancouver. The campus is easily accessible by transit.

International students at TWU benefit from dedicated international services, English for Academic Purposes preparation, and BC's strong immigration pathways. Graduates from eligible programs qualify for the Post-Graduation Work Permit and BC Provincial Nominee Program.
paragraphsRu: Trinity Western University (TWU) — частный христианский университет в Лэнгли, Британская Колумбия. Основан в 1962 году, более 4 500 студентов, предлагает программы в области бизнеса, науки, медсестринства, образования и гуманитарных наук.
TWU известен сильным чувством общности, небольшими группами и образованием на основе ценностей. Программы медсестринства, MBA, психологии и образования высоко оценены.
Расположенный в Лэнгли, в 50 км к востоку от центра Ванкувера, студенты TWU пользуются доступом к обширному рынку труда и культуре Большого Ванкувера.
Выпускники имеют право на Post-Graduation Work Permit и BC Provincial Nominee Program.
